g_notes: SKIP — candidate-facing technical support FAQ (browser errors, Event ID lookup, file upload formats, login/loading issues). This is product support for test-takers, not a hiring/assessment content topic; job-seeker-facing content is explicitly off our world per brand scope.

angle_gap: The page is tagged FAQ but contains no actual Q&A — it's a directory of gated resources (2026 Candidate Experience Report, Hiring Benchmark Report, ROI of Pre-Employment Assessments eBook, structured-interview guide, DEI-in-hiring eBook) that never answers a single question on the page itself; a recruiter has to click through and hand over an email just to get any answer.
asset: Pre-Employment Testing and Structured Interviews: The Answers Recruiters Search For, Not Gated Behind an eBook
distinct_angle: Answers the real questions recruiters have — does pre-employment testing pay for itself, how do you run a structured interview, how do you reduce bias in hiring — directly on the page in FAQ form, instead of forcing a download the way this page does for every one of its topics.
